title: Sparse RL Relaxation for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work has explored continuous representations in place of discrete tokens during Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, often referred to as soft CoT. This is motivated by the idea that a mixture of token embeddings can represent a superposition of multiple reasoning possibilities within a single step. However, it remains challenging to train large language models to realize this potential. Existing work has explored reinforcement learning (RL)-style training for soft CoT. However, these approaches treat soft tokens as actions in a Markov decision process rather than as differentiable intermediate computation steps. Thus, they do not propagate gradients across the soft tokens and miss out on the signal of how the choice of one soft token affects the next. In this paper, we propose a sparse relaxation method for RL (called SpaRLax), which leverages the differentiability of soft-CoT reasoning over time steps and makes training more stable

translated_title: 面向大语言模型推理的稀疏强化学习松弛方法
translated_abstract: 近期的研究探索了在思维链推理过程中使用连续表示来替代离散词元，这种方法通常被称为“软思维链”。其动机在于：词元嵌入的混合可以在单个步骤中表示多种推理可能性的叠加。然而，训练大语言模型以实现这一潜力仍然具有挑战性。现有工作探索了基于强化学习风格的软思维链训练，但这些方法将软词元视为马尔可夫决策过程中的动作，而非可微分的中间计算步骤。因此，它们无法在软词元之间传播梯度，错失了关于一个软词元的选择如何影响下一个软词元的信号。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于强化学习的稀疏松弛方法，该方法利用软思维链推理在时间步上的可微分性，使训练更加稳定。
tldr: 提出了一种用于强化学习的稀疏松弛方法 SpaRLax，通过利用软思维链推理在时间步上的可微分性来传播梯度，从而实现更稳定的大语言模型推理训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes SpaRLax, a sparse relaxation method for RL that leverages the differentiability of soft-CoT reasoning across time steps to propagate gradients, enabling more stable training for LLM reasoning.
